data.narrative:
Orbital Operations is a Seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Ben Schleuniger and Ross Doherty that has raised $8.8M to date. The broader Space & Aerospace sector comprises 5 publicly traded companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and a substantive private peer set including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method here. Using the $8.8M total raised as a proxy for current base value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions, this method implies a valuation of $22M. This represents the primary quantitative anchor for the analysis. Peer-median triangulation was not feasible due to absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Space & Aerospace peer set (0 datapoints met filter criteria). Public-comp anchoring using the sector median P/S of 27.4x across six public names cannot be applied without the target's revenue, which is not on file for this private company.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $19M to $25M, centered on $22M. The primary uncertainty stems from reliance on a single method; a more robust triangulation would require either disclosed revenue figures to enable public-comp anchoring or identification of sufficiently granular private peer financing data at matching stage and scale.
